evidence.quote: In 1989, a box was left at the visitor center.  It contained one of the Chinese Guardian Lions which had been stolen in the 1934 theft.

evidence.claim: Chinese goldminers built the first temple in 1853; the present building replaced fire-destroyed predecessors in 1874.
evidence.quote:
The original temple was built in 1853 by Chinese goldminers during the California gold rush.
The current building, called The Temple among the Forest beneath the Clouds (雲林廟), was built in 1874 to replace earlier structures which had been destroyed by fires.

evidence.claim: After that theft, local resident Moon Lim Lee became trustee and campaigned for state protection.

evidence.claim: Jacob Bowerman built this barn by hand in 1878, using whipsawn pine and board-and-batten siding.
evidence.quote: The barn was built in 1878 by Jacob Bowerman, a local cattle rancher. Bowerman built the barn by hand with whipsawn pine wood and board and batten siding

evidence.claim: His ranch supplied beef and dairy products to wholesalers and businesses in Minersville.
evidence.quote: Bowerman sold beef and dairy products to wholesalers and businesses in Minersville

evidence.claim: The ranch also included a house, milk house and wagon shed, all later lost to fire.
evidence.quote: The barn served as part of Bowerman's ranch, which originally included a ranch house, milk house, and wagon shed, all of which burned down.

evidence.claim: After Bowerman died in 1917, the barn served sheep farming and storage until the Forest Service bought the property in 1974.
evidence.quote: Bowerman died in 1917, and the barn was subsequently used for sheep farming and storage until the U.S. Forest Service purchased the property in 1974.

evidence.claim: The historic barn is on Guy Covington Drive southwest of Trinity Center.
evidence.quote: The Bowerman Barn is a historic barn located on Guy Covington Drive southwest of Trinity Center, California.

evidence.claim: The barn entered the National Register of Historic Places in 1981, seven years after the federal purchase.
evidence.quote: The barn was added to the National Register of Historic Places on March 20, 1981.
